title: Space intersection (A B) gives #NULL! on disjoint areas, #VALUE! across sheets or 3-D spans, and #REF! in INDIRECT
statement: In Excel 16.0 (measured 2026-10-23), the space intersection operator (A B) returns the shared cells of two references on the same sheet, #NULL! when the areas do not overlap (=SUM((A1:A2 B1:B2)) = #NULL!), and #VALUE! when operands lie on different sheets (=SUM((S1!A1:A2 S2!A1:A2)) = #VALUE!) or involve 3-D references (=SUM(Ja:Ma!A1:A2 Ja:Ma!A1) = #VALUE!). Excel 16.0 build 20430 saves =A1:A3 A2:C2 as a dynamic-array formula (cm="1"), whereas INDIRECT("A1 B1") in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 returns #REF!.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0 (2026-10-23 readings recorded in refops.rs and acceptance/l1.rs), Excel 16.0 build 20430 (d1/excel-file-form.json), and Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (dc_51ka row 52).
